A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same OVBEVSeg research work, including the complete main text and supplementary Appendices A–G. Text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original nuScenes experiments, including BEV segmentation comparisons, component ablations, and supplementary language-disentanglement and 3D detection results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in Tables 1–8 and A1–A4, together with qualitative reconstruction and segmentation evaluations.

M1.justification: The PBL, BAGS, and BAGD procedures, Lang–BAGS extension, training objectives, and inference architecture remain unchanged in Section 3 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same nuScenes coverage, including novel-class BEV segmentation, non-vehicle categories, map segmentation, and supplementary open-vocabulary 3D detection. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout Tables 1–8 and A1–A4, including the closed-set and semi-supervised baselines, LangSplat comparison, and BEVDet/BEVFormer detection comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C retain the same dataset splits, base/novel categories, visibility filtering, BEV resolution, metrics, training budget, and checkpoint-selection procedure.

E4.justification: The component, 3D-prior, and distillation-ratio ablations are unchanged. Appendix D retains the same pseudo-label analyses, loss comparisons, disentanglement study, and top-K gating analysis; the qualitative case studies also match.

E5.justification: Appendix A specifies the same fixed random seed, 2025, in both versions. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance testing.

E6.justification: All numerical result entries and qualitative findings match. Examples include 19.3 mean IoU in Table 1, 15.3 novel-class mIoU in Table 3, and 30.8 NDS with 24.1 mAP in Table A4.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, and geometric derivations in Equations (1)–(8) and (A1)–(A6) are unchanged. No formal assumptions, proofs, or theoretical results are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same OVBS contribution, three-stage geometric framework, generalization claims, and efficiency claims. The added acceptance note does not change the scientific claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the ablations and geometric improvements remain unchanged. Appendix B retains the limitations concerning offline optimization cost and missing temporal consistency; Appendix E retains the same explanation of visualization artifacts.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page URL on the first page, providing a new resource-access pointer. Implementation details, hardware, runtimes, and processing instructions are unchanged; the PDFs do not establish a new code or data release.

R1.justification: Research positioning and citation contexts remain unchanged. References 3 and 9 receive bibliographic updates, including the CoT-PL-to-MSPL title update under the same authors, while several existing references gain URLs. These are updates to matched references.

P1.justification: v2 changes 'Dae Jung Kim' to 'Daejung Kim' in both author lists, adds an ECCV 2026 acceptance note and project-page line, and updates bibliography metadata. The scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 colors citations, cross-references, and external links, with small spacing and reflow adjustments in the front matter and bibliography. Figure imagery, vector diagrams, table structures, and their placement remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The project-page pointer, bibliography updates, and colored links provide small access and presentation conveniences. The complete scientific argument, experimental evidence, implementation documentation, and limitations remain unchanged, so the revision does not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
